purpose: Rules for running Python scripts and managing dependencies with uv, so version numbers are chosen and written by uv rather than by humans or AI.
summary: Scope: applies only when project instructions mandate uv; distribution to users needs a judgment
Where to declare dependencies: PEP 723 inline metadata vs project-root pyproject.toml
Execution: run Python scripts with uv run, declare Python version and deps in inline metadata
Adding and removing dependencies via uv add/remove --script with --bounds lower, after user permission
Never write version numbers by hand; lower bound only sets candidates, lockfile decides the version
Locking: uv lock --script, commit lockfile, uv run --locked detects mismatch
Updating: uv tree --outdated, uv lock --upgrade, review lockfile diff before commit
Supply-chain defense: exclude-newer = "3 days", with per-package exception for urgent security fixes
Python version: requires-python lower bound follows latest stable, excluding alpha/beta/rc
tasks: Writing or modifying a Python script that uses uv
Adding, removing, or upgrading a script dependency
Choosing between PEP 723 metadata and pyproject.toml
Creating or updating a lockfile for a script
Deciding whether to apply uv to distributed scripts
title: uv 利用ルール
